question.text:
Match Column I with Column II

  Column I   Column II
A Soda ash I CaSO4
B Chlorophyll II CaOH2
C Used in Whitewashing III Na2CO3
D Dentistry, ornamental work IV Mg2+ ions

options.text: A – III, B – IV, C – I, D – II
A – II, B – I, C – III, D – IV
A – III, B – I, C – II, D – IV
A – II, B – III, C – IV, D – I

solution.text: Sodium carbonate <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><msub><mi>Na</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><msub><mi>CO</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> also known as washing soda, soda ash and soda crystals. In chlorophyll the central ion is magnesium, and the large organic molecule is a porphyrin. Whitewash, lime paint is a type of paint made from slaked lime (calcium hydroxide,<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo> </mo><mi>Ca</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>OH</mi><msub><mo>)</mo><mn>2</mn></msub></math>) or chalk calcium carbonate, (<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CaCO</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math>). <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CaSO</mi><mn>4</mn></msub></math> is used in dentistry and ornamental work.
